continuity: Mae Jonghak and the New Murim Alliance have prepared a coordinated operation against Dark Heaven; Zhuge Feng is tasked with carrying it out using Song Ho’s intelligence and selected allies.
Zhuge Feng orders the Zhuge Clan to leave its current home immediately.
Mae Jonghak leaves the Zhuge Clan garden after entrusting the operation to Zhuge Feng; his destination is not stated.
plot: Mae Jonghak reveals that a long-prepared opportunity to strike back against Dark Heaven has arrived. He gives Zhuge Feng Song Ho’s secret list of embedded spies, allies, and meeting locations, then leaves; Zhuge Feng prepares the Zhuge Clan to evacuate immediately and urges Jin Taekyung to hold on in the west.

active_continuity: The Yangtze River Channel League and Green Forest Alliance are advancing west in a large combined force.
Dark Heaven reinforcements are joining through Moving Formations; their locations remain unknown.
Mae Jonghak and the New Murim Alliance have prepared an operation against Dark Heaven; Zhuge Feng has the intelligence and tasking to execute it.
The Zhuge Clan is preparing to leave its current home immediately.
Zhuge Feng urges Jin Taekyung to hold on in the west.
open_questions: What is the black-robed captive in Qinghai’s identity and what does he know?
Why did the Lord of Heaven spare Taekyung in Gansu, and what is his real purpose?
Will the Alliance Leader and other righteous warriors reach Qinghai?
What is the hidden ember Cheongheoja warned about?
Who is the black-robed man beside Pa Ryun?

names.notes: Epithet of the thief said to be able to steal from heaven.
